deliveryMode.description: How the area's last mile is served (ADR 0016): the network's own route, or a handoff to an external carrier at a network node. An absent mode is NETWORK_ROUTE, the behaviour every area had before the mode existed.
deliveryMode.title: DeliveryMode

carriers.description: The declared carrier options; omitted when the area is a NETWORK_ROUTE area.

items.description: One declared external carrier of a CARRIER_HANDOFF area: where the network hands packages over and what the carrier declares the trip costs (integer cents per package) and takes (minutes). The per-package choice is computed downstream from the declared options, never chosen by an operator at handoff.

carrierId.description: The carrier's own identifier, unique within the area.

handoffNodeId.description: Must be an ACTIVE DELIVERY_STATION or SORTATION_CENTER.

costPerPackageCents.description: The carrier's declared cost of delivering one package, integer cents (no currency; single-currency study).

transitMinutes.description: The carrier's declared transit from the handoff node to the doorstep, in minutes.

items.title: CarrierOption

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared not-found, illegal-transition, concurrent-update and validation-failed, or one of this context's, e.g. stale-profile-revision or inbound-limits-not-allowed.
